exposure: Number of annual deliveries at the readmitting facility
outcome: Nontransfusion severe maternal morbidity (SMM) during readmission
cohort: The study included 29,472 postpartum patients who were readmitted for pre-eclampsia with severe features from 2015-2019.
finding: Nontransfusion severe maternal morbidity for postpartum readmissions with pre-eclampsia with severe features was inversely associated with the readmitting hospital's delivery volume.
followup_time: Median 3.9 days (25th-75th percentile: 2.2-6.5 days) postpartum for readmission
